item.title: St. Francisville hosts annual Christmas in the Country parade
item.description: ST. FRANCISVILLE -&nbsp;The annual Christmas in the Country parade rolled through St. Francisville on Sunday, spreading holiday cheer as beads were tossed out to parade-goers along the route.&nbsp;The parade featured about 30 floats, all decorated to fit this year's theme, "Meet Me Under The Mistletoe." item.title: Pierre Part Fire and Rescue responds to kitchen fire on Highway 70
item.description: ASSUMPTION -&nbsp;Pierre Part Fire and Rescue responded to a Sunday afternoon kitchen fire on Highway 70.&nbsp;According to officials, the fire began around 12:10 p.m. due to an unattended pot on the stove.Fire crews removed the hazard, cut off the power, and ventilated the trailer, leaving the kitchen with minor damage.&nbsp;There were no reported injuries.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Gray's Army hosts fourth annual gumbo dinner
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Livingston Parish nonprofit Gray's Army hosted its fourth annual gumbo dinner Sunday night, inviting the community to share in a night of food, music and family.&nbsp;The group is named after Grayson Temple. item.title: Livingston residents gather for annual tree lighting ceremony
item.description: LIVINGSTON - The Town of Livingston lit up its main tree Sunday night during the yearly Light Up Livingston celebration.&nbsp;Each year, residents make the long-time tradition bigger and better. This year, the tree was a record-breaking 27 feet tall.&nbsp;People enjoyed hot chocolate and Christmas treats while listening to carolers and the band from Doyle High School.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Rotary Club of Livingston Parish asking for volunteers for Veteran Angel Tree
item.description: DENHAM SPRINGS - The Rotary Club of Livingston Parish is sponsoring an Angel Tree for veterans this Christmas season.&nbsp;There are more than 20 ornaments up for grabs at James Restaurant and donations are due no later than 2 p.m. on Thursday, Dec. 18.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments
